content: [diagnostics-1] Compare stationary pose and short/long transition contact gaps [self]
findings: At default 1.7m height, most stationary fixtures have no visible warning; stationary arabesque has ~6mm model shortfall (over 5mm display threshold). First→second in place clean; moving it 0.1m gives ~12mm maximum gap; 4m gives ~999mm. none→none 0.3m gives ~11mm, 0.9m ~67mm, 4m ~804mm. These are model measurements, not validated human limits. Reproduce with node test-transition-diagnostics.mjs.
